additional_info.subject: RE: ID0474123-DC/Si-D/IT- [Multi] Charger Connection Issue CRM:03288000202
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Maria,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0474123.
The ticket was opened for chargers
Y2 / S1 313508370023
and
Y2 / S1 313508370017
being Unavailable on Sifinity.
I took a look at both chargers this morning and, despite they were actually recognized as unavailable on Sifinity, on our Siemens Backend they were available and fully operative.
I checked and it seemed that there was a sync issue in the status/availability reported between SCB and Sifinity. I asked R&D to correct this sync issue, and the chargers are now correctly reported on Sifinity.
Since the issue has been identified and solved, I will proceed to close the ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
